study_identification_part.si_4_title: Atypical maturation of the functional connectome hierarchy in autism

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized ABIDE-I (discovery dataset), ABIDE-II (replication dataset), and HCP-D (Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development) for normative modeling.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), termed the ABIDE I and II... were analyzed... we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset

answer.HCP-D: normative training for the base model

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCP-D was used to build the reference normative model. ABIDE-I and II were used for clinical research to evaluate deviations in individuals with ASD. A longitudinal subset of ABIDE-II was used for validation.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: To construct a normative developmental trajectory, we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy... from the HCP-D dataset... We utilized ABIDE-I data for the primary normative modeling analyses, and the reproducibility was assessed using ABIDE-II data... we conducted an additional analysis using the ABIDE-II longitudinal dataset

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The base normative model was trained on 652 healthy controls from HCP-D. The overall phase includes the training set and the healthy control groups from ABIDE-I (N=369) and ABIDE-II (N=355) used for intercept adjustment and replication comparisons.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: a cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset... A normative model... was constructed using the HCP-D dataset and then transferred to the TD group of the ABIDE dataset.
